Scalar prototype API checkpoint (2026-10-17): IPCAPI prototypes now borrow actual CHAR/packed fields with exact formal/actual counts, lengths/scales and live aliases. Typed immutable constants use independent checked buffers; duplicate/missing metadata and unsupported options reject before service mutation. Private named formal storage avoids caller collisions; ordinary targets retain lazy copied argument/writeback semantics. Nested expression separators, literal colons and doubled apostrophes are supported. Full prototype modes, native storage and general ILE binding remain open. Prototype checkpoint verification: 49 new cases and all 1433 tests pass, zero failures/skips; locked restore, zero-warning/error Release build, full terminal PTY with prototyped keyed queue calls and generated inventory validation pass. Six QSYS IPCAPI adapters implement native binary parameters, SPCA0100 attributes, aligned keyed attribute records, optional groups and checked writable/error receivers. CRTUSRSPC extension and exact-name DLTUSRSPC are executable. QTEMP job-private object storage, generic deletion names, MI/list APIs, full native lock/error/domain relocation behavior remain open; C11/C14 stay unchecked. Native message API checkpoint (2026-10-17): six QSYS adapters implement finite QMHSNDPM/QMHRCVPM/QMHSNDM/QMHRCVM/QMHSNDRM/QMHRTVM contracts over shared named/program queues and saved descriptions. RCVM0100/0200 and RTVM0100 use checked binary receivers, opaque keys, conversion statuses, truncation and prepared output before state/removal/reply commits. Independent vectors cover CYYMMDD century boundaries, native sender/profile offsets, incomplete groups, invalid receivers, FIRST/NEXT retrieval and empty-table deleted-key preservation. CL/RPG callers, shared/reopened hosts, separate-process atomic snapshots, authority/signing/manifests and socket-job changes have acceptance coverage. WRKAPILS now discovers 18 adapters. System-value library defaults are bounded to native 15/25 names, separate from running-job 250. Legacy oversized values fail without truncation. A false RPG IF now enters its ELSE body, with fixed/free/nested regression cases. Protected/lockable values, wider native catalog/formats and broader C09/C14/C18 contracts remain open. Native job API checkpoint (2026-10-17): QSYS/QUSRJOBI supports JOBI0100 basic metadata and protected active-job JOBI0700 libraries; QUSLJOB produces JOBL0100 and JOBL0200 with 17 backed keys. Shared schema-28 opaque IDs and authenticated 48-byte cursors persist across ordinary catalog opens and refresh atomically at exclusive host startup. List publication preserves caller/tail bytes, implicitly grows existing spaces regardless of auto-extension, checks live authority and EXCLRD allocations, and rolls back bytes/size/change state on failure/cancellation. Real maximum-space continuation covers 3000 jobs and 64 repeated keys, tampered, foreign, mismatched and stale handles. Terminal history is not mislabeled OUTQ. Wider job formats, unbacked counters, spool integration and remaining API/cryptography families keep C09/C14 open: 35 complete / 71 open. Final native job API verification (2026-10-17): all 2174 tests pass, zero failures/skips, including 66 additional job-layout, opaque-ID, migration, cursor, CL/RPG, socket and raw-EVAL cases. Schema-28 backfill and exclusive-host epoch refresh preserve job data; list generation preserves caller/tail bytes, grows implicitly and continues at the real maximum with authenticated handles. Wider API families/formats, performance statistics, spool integration and broader C09/C14 work remain open. Checklist stays 35 complete / 71 open. Native date API checkpoint (2026-10-17): QSYS/QWCCVTDT now accepts complete 5/10/11-argument groups and native short/long calendar/Julian date-time layouts, CURRENT/SYSVAL/DTS and DOS formats. The shared timestamp codec preserves standard 52-bit microsecond/12-bit uniqueness semantics; the API applies its eight-microsecond conversion quantum and native millisecond rounding/ranges/wrap rules. Character conversion preserves unvalidated time bytes and short century copy behavior. UTC/actual host-zone conversion validates DST gaps, supports both repeated-time segments and rounds on the UTC instant across transitions. UTC/out-of-range information receivers use zero binary/blank character fields and preserve tails. Compiled CL/direct RPG at CCSIDs 37/1208, live program authority/signing/manifests, output preparation/cancellation and real terminal flows have acceptance coverage. WRKAPILS discovers 21 adapters. Job DATFMT/time-zone attributes, named TIMZON objects and in-range host-zone metadata are explicitly unsupported pending shared services. Wider C14 API/crypto requirements remain open: 35 complete / 71 open. See docs/date-time-apis.md for exact layouts, selectors and errors. Final native date API verification (2026-10-17): all 2240 tests pass, zero failures/skips, including 66 new timestamp/layout/range/copy/DST/DOS/control/error/cancellation and CL/RPG integration cases. All 74 focused cases, locked restore, zero-warning/error Release solution build, expanded display PTY with compiled CL/direct RPG microsecond timestamp round-trips and WRKAPILS details, generated inventory and whitespace checks pass. Published MI vectors verify the shared full-precision codec; QWCCVTDT conversion applies an eight-microsecond quantum inferred from IBM precision notes/endpoints. Native copy rules preserve raw time/century bytes where validation is not required. Rounding across DST and New Year, invalid local times, both repeated-time segments and atomic output preparation are verified. WRKAPILS discovers 21 adapters. Job DATFMT/time-zone attributes, named TIMZON objects, in-range host-zone metadata and wider API/crypto families remain open. Checklist stays 35 complete / 71 open. Native cryptography checkpoint (2026-10-17): six QSYS QC3 adapters now provide hash/HMAC, AES encrypt/decrypt and opaque job-owned key contexts through shared .NET services. Five hashes, three AES key sizes, ECB/CBC/CTR, native padding, checked DATA0100/ALGD0500/ALGD0200/KEYD0100/0200 descriptors and atomic output/ length/error preparation have published known-answer acceptance. CL/direct RPG at CCSIDs 37/1208 and real PTY run all six programs; independent socket jobs verify cross-call use, foreign-token denial and signoff cleanup. Final C14 cryptography verification (2026-10-17): all 2309 tests pass, zero failures/skips, including 69 new crypto, key-context, migration, native CL/RPG/socket and writable-substring cases. All 176 focused cases, locked restore, zero-warning/error Release solution build, expanded display PTY with all six QC3 adapters and registry details, generated inventory and whitespace checks pass. Published NIST/RFC vectors cover five hashes/HMACs and AES 128/192/256 in ECB/CBC/CTR; native padding, key types/lengths, maximum key size, per-job limits, atomic receivers and cancellation are verified. Schema-29 encrypted context storage supports same-job reopen, denies foreign/JOBCTL access, authenticates ciphertext, participates in wrapping inventory/rotation and releases with completion/recovery. Failed create/cleanup/rewrap/migration preserve prior state. Independent socket jobs verify cross-call use, foreign-token denial and signoff cleanup; the actual server recovers contexts before readiness. Writable scalar RPG %SUBST preserves bytes/tails, checks ranges and retains literal text. WRKAPILS discovers 27 adapters; the normalized compatibility catalog has 304 entries. C14 software cryptography/key-management acceptance is complete under docs/cryptography-apis.md and the release contract. The three broader C14 API/ABI/reference-suite items and general C09/ILE work remain open. Checklist is now 36 complete / 70 open. Range-aware alias checks preserve data before dequeue/error reporting, and indexed addresses are captured at call entry. Native initialization, numeric metadata, array arithmetic and bounds are covered by focused tests; see docs/rpg-native-structures.md. Nested/fixed/external layouts, full entry/prototype ABI and INFDS/PSDS/INDDS remain open; status remains partial. Native byte/array/initialization, receiver lifetime/alias/UTF-8, saved-source and retained activation cases are verified. Broader C09/C14 requirements remain partial; checklist stays 36 complete / 70 open. Broader requirements stay partial; checklist remains 36 complete / 70 open.
